survey: Inflatable beach ball resting on sand. Body: a sphere, seen from slightly above. The fitted ellipse has width ratio 0.99 and is off a true ellipse by 0.5%, so the outline is round. Panels: six gores that alternate white and colour (white, red, white, green, white, blue) as a real beach ball does. Each seam runs from the top pole toward the hidden bottom pole. Cap: a round purple valve cap sits at the top pole, tilted toward the camera, and every gore ends at its rim. Support: the ball sits in the sand with a contact shadow under it, so it is not floating. The tools found no thin parts, loose ends or branches.
